mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within the last month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over the last two months signals increased consumer demand and economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST shows a sustained increase over the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% within the last two months signals increased supply-side capacity, which can lead to increased competition and reduced profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1% within the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and the consumer price index increases by more than 0.5% in the last month, it signals inflationary pressure and tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with high interest rates
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2% within the last month, it signals a strong labor market and potential wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures by more than 1% over the last month signals a weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when RSAFS decreases by more than 1% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production increases by more than 1% and GDP increases by more than 0.5% over the last quarter, it signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 1% and GDPC1 increases > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both conditions are met.
